description: This file defines the class MockPRMZoneCluster, which extends MockZoneCluster. It provides a mock implementation for a PRM zone cluster, including methods for handling specific manufacturer attributes such as zone type and configuration. The class appears to facilitate testing or simulation of device clusters with custom manufacturer data.
